Wrote `JUDGMENT.json` for occurrence `3610840341|3600904607`.

**Semantic question:** Whether discharge occurred during Federal FY2025 so the TSS daily-maximum mass-load (lb/d) monitoring requirement conditioned on `WHEN DISCHARGING` was applicable.

**Disposition:** `SUPPORTED_RESOLUTION`

**Basis:** Permit NM0028762 (Aztec) authorizes intermittent backwash discharge from Outfall 001 and ties TSS monitoring to footnote “*1 When discharging.” For limit value 3610840341, DMR data show numeric daily-max TSS mass loads (lb/d) in all 12 FY2025 months, with companion nonzero flow reports on the same schedule and no NODI/no-discharge indicators. That supports discharge in each evaluated month and conditional monitoring applicability.

**Remaining uncertainty:** Day-level discharge timing and whether every required weekly grab was taken are not established; resolution is at the monthly monitoring-period level.
